upload.title: Upload Paper
upload.desc: Upload your raw manuscript directly to the system. The system scans and parses the content.

data_vision.title: Data & Vision Validation
data_vision.desc: Rigorous statistical validation between Excel data and graph displays using advanced computational tools.

predict_pre.title: Acceptance Predictor
predict_pre.desc: Checks journal metrics and analyzes the initial acceptance probability against academic standards.

clarification.title: Clarification Agent
clarification.desc: Extracts editorial goals and journal constraints to build a focused research strategy.

planning.title: Planning Agent
planning.desc: Draws trends from GraphRAG and builds a detailed architectural work plan for all paper sections.

knowledge.title: Knowledge & Reference Agent
knowledge.desc: Actively searches for sources and supporting literature in real-time via PubMed to verify citations.

sci_review.title: SciReview Debate
sci_review.desc: A simulated peer review consisting of multiple agents debating the paper's research limitations.

area_chair.title: Area Chair (o1)
area_chair.desc: Synthesizes the reviewers' debate conclusions into a deep, actionable, and clear action plan.

writer.title: Writing & Personalization
writer.desc: Iterative rewriting of text to high scientific standards, while pulling your style preferences from Mem0.

execution.title: Execution Agent
execution.desc: Implements all recommended corrections into the document in a secure sandbox, creating a full changelog.

qa.title: QA Agent
qa.desc: Strict consistency, formatting, and grammar check to ensure no errors remain before submission.

verification.title: Verification & Cover Letter
verification.desc: Fully verifies adherence to journal guidelines and drafts a persuasive cover letter to the Editor-in-Chief.

compile.title: Compile & Reinject
compile.desc: Final compilation of all paper components into a ready file, restoring Mendeley citations accurately.

export.title: Export & Publish
export.desc: Journey complete! You can now download the full submission package (final file, tracked changes, cover letter).

security.title: Journal Connection Security Briefing
security.whyCredentials: Why do we need your credentials?
security.whyCredentialsDesc: To submit your paper automatically, our system needs to authenticate with the journal's platform (like WordPress or OJS) on your behalf.
security.encryption: Credentials are encrypted using military-grade AES-256-GCM encryption before being saved.
security.neverPlaintext: We never store your passwords in plain text.
security.deleteAnytime: You can delete your connection at any time.
security.consent: I understand and agree to securely store my credentials.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Please enter the 2FA code sent to your device.
